.. Decipher documentation master file

🔍 Decipher — AI Vocabulary Learning App
==========================================

.. image:: https://img.shields.io/badge/Gemini_2.5-4285F4?style=flat-square&logo=google&logoColor=white
   :alt: Gemini 2.5
.. image:: https://img.shields.io/badge/Firebase-FF6F00?style=flat-square&logo=firebase&logoColor=white
   :alt: Firebase
.. image:: https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-339933?style=flat-square&logo=node.js&logoColor=white
   :alt: Node.js

**Upload any text, PDF, image, or YouTube video. AI extracts vocabulary, translates it, and trains you until every word sticks.**

Decipher is a full-stack AI-powered vocabulary learning web application. It combines Google Gemini 2.5 Flash, Firebase, and the Web Speech API into a cinematic, single-page experience where users can understand, remember, and quiz themselves on difficult vocabulary from any source.
